item.description:
# Shruti 1.4.6
- Fixes Audio Devices, Scenes, Settings and Output Groups controls when Shruti is pinned as a floating panel; every footer control now opens the same real window from either UI. - Finds playback apps using both the installed-app directory and live Core Audio evidence, so newly observed apps appear without needing a hard-coded catalogue entry. - Makes Claude and ChatGPT searchable playback apps and lets vendor-style searches such as “Google Chrome” match an app whose display name is simply “Chrome”. - Keeps the live mixer focused on apps producing output now, with a three-second anti-flicker grace instead of retaining silent utilities or every installed application. - Removes playback-driven “smart” reordering. Your order remains fixed, hidden apps retain their positions, and newly heard apps join without making existing rows fight. - Makes Compact a genuine two-line mixer layout so app names remain readable while level, boost, output and FX controls remain available. - Replaces the vague “fix volume keys” prompt with a contextual Mac volume-keys setup for fixed-volume HDMI, display, TV and audio-interface outputs.
